title: Danganronpa: The Animation
label: Quick read (from summaries)
premise: A four-volume manga based on the anime of the Spike Chunsoft video game. Ordinary student Makoto Naegi wins a lottery place at the elite Hope's Peak Academy, only to find himself and gifted classmates such as Sayaka Maizono and Hifumi Yamada trapped by Monokuma, a robot teddy-bear principal. The only way out is to murder a classmate and get away with it, and every killing is followed by a class trial in which survivors cross-examine each other (Dark Horse blurb; Otaku USA review).
life_message: Trust and reasoning together are tested, and sought, under a regime that rewards betraying one another.
